extracted.name: My favourite Tomato Salad
extracted.description: A big, juicy tomato salad is a staple everyone should know how to make well! Rather than shaking up a dressing, sprinkle the garlic, eshallots/shallots and salt straight onto the tomato wedges. The flavour sticks better.Use everyday red tomatoes though if you can get them, heirloom tomatoes will add a great splash of colour.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 tsp finely minced garlic ((use a knife, not garlic press))
1 1/2 tbsp finely sliced basil leaves (, plus extra for garnish (Note 4))
instruction_lines: Cut the tomatoes into 8 or 10 wedges, cutting out the core. Place in a large bowl.
Sprinkle over eschallots, garlic, salt and pepper. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar.
Gently toss to coat tomatoes. Add basil, toss again to disperse.
Pour into bowl and serve immediately! (Tip: Bread for mopping up the tomato juices is on point).
